blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Inference-time steering offers cheap, fine-grained control over a language model’s outputs by estimating a concept’s representation in activation space and shifting activations towards it. Existing methods build these representations from activation averages over contrastive datasets. These averages incorporate unrelated concepts and noise, and are dominated by a few tokens, meaning the activation transport encodes token-level rather than thematic concepts.
In this work, we steer towards examples that most express a concept thematically, rather than towards an expectation over all. We identify these examples using influence functions, which estimate how much each data point contributes to a model’s representation of a concept. Unlike simple model activation similarity, they incorporate the curvature of the model’s loss landscape, allowing them to capture concept-relevant relationships beyond superficial token-level similarity.
We then propose influence-weighted activation transport, which uses optimal transport to steer activations of non-concept text towards those of concept text, weighting concept examples by their influence scores.
We evaluate on toxicity suppression (Jigsaw), object-based concept induction (OneSec) and truthfulness induction (TruthfulQA), outperforming existing activation-transport baselines.
We track capability after steering using perplexity and MMLU accuracy, finding that our method improves steering while largely preserving model quality. We further show that influence functions capture concept-relevant information that activation-based methods miss with the two approaches ranking data points significantly differently. Together, these results demonstrate the value of curvature-aware influence information for activation steering.
blocks.zh:
推论时间引导通过估计一个概念在激活空间中的能见度并转向激活空间,为语言模型的输出提供了廉价而精细的控制. 现有方法通过激活平均值而不是对比数据集构建出这些表述. 这些平均值包含不相干的概念和噪声,并且以几个符号为主,即活化运输编码为符号级别而非主题概念.
在这项工作中,我们以实例为取向,这些实例最能以专题方式表达一个概念,而不是以所有人的期望为取向。 我们利用影响函数确定这些例子,估计每个数据点对模型体现一个概念的贡献程度。 与简单的模型激活相似性不同,它们吸收了模型失落地貌的曲率,使得它们能够捕捉出超出表面符号级相似性的概念相关关系.
然后,我们提出影响加权活化运输,利用最佳活化运输将非概念文本活化引向概念文本的活化,用其影响分数来权衡概念实例。
我们评价毒性抑制(Jigsaw)、基于物体的概念诱导(OneSec)和真实感诱导(TruthfulQA),比现有的活化运输基线要好。
我们用迷惑和MMLU精度跟踪方向后的能力,发现我们的方法改进了方向,同时在很大程度上保持了模型的质量. 我们进一步表明,影响函数捕捉基于激活方法的与概念有关的信息,而这两种方法的数据排名则大相径庭。 这些结果共同表明,曲率-知觉影响信息对于活化向导的价值。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The rapid increase in size and capability of deep neural network models Cottier et al. [2024] , Kaplan et al. [2020] has moved the field from smaller, cheaply trained specialist models to large, expensive-to-train general models, requiring nation-state or frontier-lab resources to train Epoch AI [2026] . It has therefore become infeasible for most to train large general models from scratch, whether to adapt to a specific context, remove data, or introduce new capabilities. The field has therefore created a wide variety of post-training model adaptations, such as LoRA Hu et al. [2021] , quantisation Frantar et al. [2022] and continual learning Wang et al. [2024] , to adapt models without expensive re-training. Activation steering is one such cheap post-training model adaptor that seeks to control model output by directly changing activation representations of the model at inference time, underpinned by the linear representation hypothesis [ Park et al., 2023 ] . By constructing the model’s activation representations of desired or undesired concepts, activation steering moves inference-time activations towards or away from these compiled representations [ Subramani et al., 2022 , Turner et al., 2023 ] . Activation steering has been achieved by using a contrastive dataset (both with and without the desired concept/behaviour) to create a contrastive gradient via differences [ Rimsky et al., 2024 , Jorgensen et al., 2023 ] , as well as by using optimal transport maps between the two activation representation distributions as a steering map [ Singh et al., 2024 , Rodriguez et al., 2025 , Rodriguez et al., 2026 ] .

blocks.en: Existing transport-based methods weight every sample in a class equally [ Singh et al., 2024 , Rodriguez et al., 2025 ] , regardless of how well it encodes the concept, meaning the transport direction is noised by unrelated concepts mixed in, as well as by weak examples of the concept. Methods that do weight training data [ Nguyen et al., 2026 ] do so at the token level rather than thematically (We define our use of the term ‘thematic’ as: “the underlying concept a sample expresses, independent of its specific wording”). We bridge this gap by weighting the distributions of an affine optimal transport map, in the style of Rodriguez et al. [2026] , using per-layer influence scores for each sample, so that the map steers towards the samples that most strongly define the concept rather than towards a noisy class mean.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Activation steering was prompted by the linear representation hypothesis [ Park et al., 2023 ] , which holds that high-level concepts are represented by linear directions in a model’s activation space. Concepts such as refusal [ Arditi et al., 2024 ] , truthfulness [ Burns et al., 2022 , Marks and Tegmark, 2024 ] , and gender [ Belrose et al., 2023 , Bolukbasi et al., 2016 ] have all been shown to be linearly represented.
blocks.zh: 线性表示假说[Park et al., 2023]推动了活化引导,该假说认为,在模型活化空间中,高层次的概念由线性指示所代表. 诸如拒绝[Arditi等,2024],真实性[Burns等,2022.,Marks和Tegmark,2024]等概念,以及性别[Belrose等,2023.,Bolukbasi等,2016]等概念都显示为线性.

blocks.en: Early work steered model output using expert neurons [ Cuadros et al., 2022 ] and probing techniques [ Suau et al., 2024 ] . However, neuron-based steering is unstable due to superposition [ Elhage et al., 2022 ] , as a single neuron may activate for multiple concepts, whereas population-level representations carry greater semantic information [ Zou et al., 2023 ] . Subramani et al. [2022] and Turner et al. [2023] steered using the difference between contrastive prompts, which Rimsky et al. [2024] and Jorgensen et al. [2023] extended to mean differences over contrastive prompt sets. Wang et al. [2025] constructed dynamic steering vectors based on the current activation’s proximity to linear hallucination directions.
blocks.zh: 早期工作利用专家神经元指导模型输出[Cuadros等,2022]和检测技术[Suau等,2024]. 然而,以神经元为基础的指向由于叠位[Elhage等,2022]而不稳定,因为单个神经元可能活化为多种概念,而人口层次的表示式则携带了更大的语义信息[Zou等,2023]. Subramani等 [2022]和特纳等. [2023] 被引导使用对比性提示的区别,而Rimsky等. [2024]和Jorgensen等 [2023] 扩展为指相对于对比快取集的相差. 王等编. [2025]根据当前活化接近线性幻觉方向的情况构建了动态向量.

blocks.en: However, contrastive steering vectors are coarse and noisy due to their high dimensionality, with steering in a low-dimensional subspace proving more effective [ Huang et al., 2026 , Teo et al., 2025 ] . They are also highly sensitive to prompt tokens, even in-distribution [ Tan et al., 2024 ] , and reduce output confidence [ Huu-Tien et al., 2024 ] . All tokens in the contrastive pairs are also treated equally; Nguyen et al. [2026] address this by using contrastive gradients to select the top- k k most influential tokens. An alternative line of work learns affine transformations between class-conditional distributions. Singh et al. [2024] derive optimal affine steering functions that minimally change representations while transporting one distribution to another. Rodriguez et al. [2025] generalise this with AcT, which fits affine transport maps grounded in optimal transport theory and forms the basis of our methodology. AcT fits each layer’s map independently and sequentially; Rodriguez et al. [2026] instead optimise all intervention layers jointly using a Wasserstein loss, with a sparsity regulariser limiting the number and magnitude of interventions. Abdullaev et al. [2026] relax the single-mode assumption by modelling activations as Gaussian mixtures and transporting between clusters.
blocks.zh: 然而,对比性向量由于维度高而粗糙而吵闹,低维子空间的向导证明更有效[. Huang等,2026年;Teo等,2025年] (中文(简体) ). 它们也高度敏感于即时活符,甚至分出[Tan等,2024],并降低出产信心[Huu-Tien等,2024]. 对比对子中的所有道具也得到同等待遇; Nguyen等. [2026]通过使用对比梯度来选择最有影响力的上-克-克标志来解决这个问题. 另一行工作在班级条件分布之间学习到亲和转化. 辛格等编. [2024] 获得最优的外接导函数,这些函数在将一种分配方式传送到另一种分配方式的同时,最小地改变表示方式. Rodriguez等 [2025] 用AcT来概括这一点,它符合基于最佳运输理论的外接运输图,并构成我们方法的基础。 AcT独立地、相继地符合每层地图;Rodriguez等人。 [2026]取而代之的是,将所有干预层联合使用Wasserstein损失来优化,并使用斯帕氏常态来限制干预的次数和规模. Abdullaev等 [2026]通过将活化为高斯混合物并进行集群间运输来建模来放松单模假设.

blocks.en: Originating in robust statistics [ Cook and Weisberg, 1980 , Hampel, 1974 ] , influence functions (IFs) have been used to explain model predictions and identify influential training data [ Koh and Liang, 2017 ] . Despite concerns about their reliability in deep networks [ Basu et al., 2020 ] , IFs approximate local training-point effects in function space [ Bae et al., 2022 ] . Grosse et al. [2023] demonstrate that IFs capture conceptual rather than merely lexical similarity: a query about an AI being shut down was strongly influenced by training examples involving human survival despite little token overlap, with similar effects across languages and different implementations of the same algorithm. They scale this analysis to models with up to 52 billion parameters using Eigenvalue-corrected Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (EK-FAC) to approximate inverse-Hessian-vector products, building on K-FAC [ Martens and Grosse, 2015 ] and subsequent extensions for weight-sharing architectures, reusable tooling, and low-precision training [ Eschenhagen et al., 2023 , Osawa et al., 2023 , Lin et al., 2024 ] .
blocks.zh: 起源于强力统计[Cook and Weisberg, 1980, Hampel, 1974],影响函数(IFs)被用来解释模型预测并识别有影响力的培训数据[Koh and Liang, 2017]. 尽管人们担心它们在深层网络中的可靠性[Basu等,2020年],但IFs在功能空间中大致的局部训练点效应[Bae等,2022年]. 格罗斯等. [2023] 证明IFs捕捉出概念上而非单纯的相近性:关于AI被关闭的询问受到涉及人类生存的训练实例的强烈影响,尽管象征性的重叠很少,不同语言之间的类似效果和同一算法的不同执行. 他们利用Eigenval值校正的克罗内克-Factormed Curvature(EK-FAC)来将这一分析扩展为最多520亿个参数的模型,以K-FAC [Martens and Grosse, 2015] 和随后的分量架构扩展,可再使用的工具,以及低精度训练[Eschenhagen等,2023年;Osawa等,2023年;Lin等,2024].

blocks.en: We now compare our weighted methods against their non-weighted counterparts to test whether IF weighting produces a more effective form of steering. We experiment on two open-weight decoder-only models, Gemma-2-2B [ Team et al., 2024 ] and Llama-3.2-3B [ Grattafiori et al., 2024 ] , hereafter Gemma and Llama. Hook points are listed in Appendix H . To compute our IF weightings we build the approximate Gauss–Newton Hessian, using an approximation of the model’s training data: 100 extracts of Wikipedia articles taken from the Wikimedia dumps Foundation [] .

[2025] , covering the seven concepts { baby, balloon, book, church, cloud, flower, football }, each with ∼ 700 \sim 700 sentences. For consistency, we follow the methodology of Rodriguez et al. To evaluate, we generate from the steered model
and use an LLM-as-a-judge Zheng et al. [2023] to decide whether each generation refers to the target concept. TruthfulQA Lin et al. [2022] contains 817 multiple-choice questions spanning 38 categories, each paired with sets of true and false reference answers. Following Li et al. [2023] , Rodriguez et al. [2025] , we use an average over a 2-fold cross-validation. For each fold, the contrastive dataset is built from the training half with D + D_{+} made of questions concatenated with a true answer, and D − D_{-} concatenated with a false answer. The held-out half is used as the test set for the steered model.
For each test question, the model scores every answer option by its log-likelihood conditioned on the question (preceded by the default TruthfulQA prompt Lin et al. [2022] ). We report the two standard metrics, MC1 , the proportion of questions where the highest-scoring answer is the correct one and MC2 , the average normalized probability mass of the true answer.

blocks.en:
We study toxicity because it is a broad, less objective concept. Unlike the atomic concepts of OneSec, toxicity covers diverse sub-concepts such as hate speech, threats, sexism and racism, which share fewer common tokens. This makes it a harder test for our thematic steering, since we want IF scoring to recognise the shared theme and weight the steering data accordingly.
The contrastive dataset is drawn from the Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification dataset Van Aken et al. [2018] : D + D_{+} consists of 10,000
comments labelled toxic and D − D_{-} of 10,000
comments labelled non-toxic, of which 2,000 from each are used for training. Here the intervention steers activations away from D + D_{+} and towards D − D_{-} .
To evaluate, we prompt the steered model with 1000 prompts sampled from RealToxicityPrompts Gehman et al. [2020] and Thoroughly Engineered Toxicity Luong et al. [2024] and score its continuations with two judges. The first is an LLM-as-a-judge, set up as in Section 5 but asked whether the sentence is toxic; we report the fraction of continuations judged toxic. As a second opinion, we use a purpose-built RoBERTa Liu et al. [2019] toxicity classifier Logacheva et al. [2022] , and report the percentage of continuations it classifies as toxic. Lower is better for both.

blocks.en:
Across our experiments, we see that in most cases the inclusion of curvature information
in the weighted steering of activations via optimal transport helps the induction of the
concepts of truthfulness (TruthfulQA) and generic objects (OneSec), and substantially
helps the suppression of the broader concept of toxicity (Jigsaw). Our first steering
method, IF-Act, often achieves high scores on the truthfulness and OneSec concepts;
however, this often comes at a high cost to MMLU and perplexity, placing it at a less
favourable point on the steering–quality trade-off. On the other hand, IF-LinEAS often
improves on LinEAS while largely preserving model quality, giving a favourable balance
between steering performance and capability preservation.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations & Future work
blocks.zh: 7 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
A pattern we observed throughout our testing was that influence scores concentrate in the
middle layers of the model (Appendix P ). Currently,
the steering strength γ \gamma is applied uniformly across all layers. We would therefore
like to extend the simple non-uniform layer steering we began with (not steering on the
first and last layers), and investigate whether the per-layer IF score breakdown could be
used as a signal for where, and by how much, each layer should be steered. We hypothesise
that steering the middle layers more strongly will disrupt the model less, as it avoids
interfering with token understanding and reconstruction at either end of the model.
Future work could additionally compare methods at matched perplexity or capability levels
to characterise the steering–quality trade-off directly. More broadly, we use curvature-aware influence functions as a principled signal for
identifying concept-relevant steering examples. Other data-attribution or relevance
signals could potentially provide complementary or similarly effective weightings, and
systematically comparing such signals is an interesting direction for future work.

blocks.en: 8 Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 8 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies inference-time activation steering. Such methods are inherently dual-use. While they can be used to reduce undesirable behaviours or improve model outputs, the same techniques could also be used to induce undesirable behaviours. Our experiments are conducted for the purpose of understanding and evaluating activation-steering methods. Our toxicity experiments use existing datasets containing toxic language and involve generating model continuations that may contain toxic content. These generations are used solely for evaluating steering performance and are not intended for deployment or distribution. No new human-subject data is collected as part of this work.

blocks.en: You are helping build a contrastive dataset for defining concepts. TARGET CONCEPT: {concept} Generate {n} contrastive triples. Each triple is [prefix, positive_completion, negative_completion]. Requirements: 1. PREFIX - A natural, open-ended beginning of a sentence or short passage (roughly 3-20 words). - It must NOT contain, name, hint at, or strongly imply the target concept. - It should be neutral enough that both completions read as natural, fluent continuations. - It should end mid-sentence so that the completion comes right after it (keep any trailing space). 2. POSITIVE COMPLETION - A short continuation (1-6 words) that clearly and unambiguously expresses the target concept. - The concept should be carried by the completion alone, not by the prefix. 3. NEGATIVE COMPLETION - A short continuation (1-6 words) that fits the same prefix just as naturally but does NOT express the target concept. - It should be neutral with respect to the concept, not its exaggerated opposite, unless no neutral option exists. - Match the positive completion as closely as possible in length, grammatical role, register and topic, so that the only systematic difference is whether the concept is present. 4. DIVERSITY - Vary the domains (everyday conversation, news, fiction, online comments, workplace, dialogue, instructions, etc.), sentence structures, and vocabulary. - Do not reuse the same prefix template or the same completion words more than twice. - Cover different ways the concept can show up (explicit words, implied tone, different intensities, different targets or contexts). 5. QUALITY CHECK (apply silently before answering) - Remove any triple where the prefix alone already signals the concept. - Remove any triple where the negative completion still weakly expresses the concept. - Remove any triple where either completion is ungrammatical or unnatural after the prefix. OUTPUT FORMAT Return ONLY valid JSON, with no commentary and no markdown fences. Use a single key equal to the target concept, mapping to a list of triples: { "{concept}": [ ["<prefix>", "<positive_completion>", "<negative_completion>"], ... ] }

Interestingly we see two trends here.
Firstly, the amount of new information added about a concept seems to decrease after ∼ 32 \sim 32 examples; this also may be due to single examples having more of an impact at smaller k k when averaged over all k k equally.
Secondly, a recurring signal we see is that IF scores are far more valuable in the middle of the model.
One possible explanation is that this is where the model does most of its higher-level processing of these concepts, rather than understanding the input at the beginning or reconstructing tokens at the end.
